settings.heading: Frequently asked questions
settings.text: Everything you need to know about shopping with us.

settings.question: Can I see products in store before I buy?
settings.answer: Yes - most of our range is on display in the showroom, and our team can show you how things work. If there's something specific you'd like to see, give us a call and we'll have it ready for you.

settings.question: How does Click & Collect work?
settings.answer: Reserve your items online, wait for our confirmation email, then collect from the store during opening hours. Please bring your order confirmation and a form of ID.

settings.question: Do you deliver and install appliances?
settings.answer: We deliver large appliances to your door and can install them and take your old appliance away. Delivery charges and availability are confirmed at checkout.

settings.question: What if I find it cheaper somewhere else?
settings.answer: Tell us - we're happy to look at matching a comparable local price on the same product. Speak to our team in store or on the phone.

settings.question: What warranty do products come with?
settings.answer: Every product comes with the manufacturer's warranty. If something goes wrong, bring it back to us and we'll help you get it sorted.

settings.question: Can I return something I've changed my mind about?
settings.answer: Unused items in their original packaging can be returned for a refund within 14 days. Some items, such as made-to-order products, may be excluded - ask us if you're unsure.

settings.question: Do you offer gift cards?
settings.answer: Yes - gift cards can be bought online or in store and make a great present for a new home.

settings.heading: Your questions answered
settings.help_text: Still need help? Call or visit the store and our team will happily sort it out.

settings.heading: Can't find your answer?
settings.text: Our team is just a phone call or a short visit away.
